rules: Existing results are preliminary hypotheses, not completed research.
Every task returns files, evidence, checks and unresolved issues.
An unknown can be a valid research result; an inaccessible page is not proof that the product has no API.
No fabricated human review, accuracy improvement or publication.
Future owners below are queued role assignments, not claims that agents are already running.
Respect user-requested review checkpoints: share the completed task's reviewed results before starting the next task.
